_about: Design rules the lint enforces. Edit here, not in lint.py. Source of the rules: docs/design-system.md and docs/working-with-rakhesh.md
banned_visible_words_note: Internal team names / acronyms and the non-preferred title must not appear in visible portfolio copy (preference: plain descriptive wording; title is Product Designer).
ratchet_note: Ratchet rules are reported and may not INCREASE versus tools/lint-baseline.json. Strokes: outline (focus rings excluded) and 2px+ borders are ratcheted because Rakhesh dislikes strokes; clean pages and lower the baseline (python3 tools/lint.py --update-baseline).
